Hello, all. I am Nurdoidz, the designer of WhoaVerse's new redesign, Minity. I designed Minity to be flexible with customizations, especially allowing versors to easily add an image banner to their subverses.

This is a simple, three-step tutorial to add a banner image to your subverse.

End Result

#header {
 background: url( %image_url% ) repeat scroll;
 height: 206px;
}

The Process

Step 1

First, we're going to upload an image to a reliable image host service. When it's uploaded and ready to be used, grab the URL and save it for later.

Note: Make sure that the URL to the image ends with a proper image file extension, like *.png, *.jpg, etc.

Step 2

Now, we're going to write some CSS. Here is our starting code:

#header {
 background: url( %image_url% );
 height: 81px;
}

Replace %image_url% with the full URL to the image.

81px is the base (minimum) height of the header and is reserved for both the top sub list and the tab menu bar. In order to show our image, we need to increase this number. If our image was 125px in height, we would add that to 81px so it can be seen:

y = 81 + 125
y = 206

So, in this case, we'd put 206px as the value for height:

#header {
 background: url( %image_url% );
 height: 206px;
}

Tip: When adding to the height value, we're basically pushing the tab menu bar down to reveal the image, which is under it.

Step 3

Finally, we just need to add a few instructions for what to do with the image:

#header {
 background: url( %image_url% ) repeat scroll;
 height: 206px;
}

Here are some common values:

  • repeat: repeats the image both vertically and horizontally.

  • repeat-x: repeats the image horizontally (left to right).

  • repeat-y: repeats the image vertically (top to bottom).

  • no-repeat: image does not repeat.

And:

  • scroll: the image scrolls with the page.

  • fixed: the image stays put even when the page scrolls.

Note: There's no specific order repeat and scroll have to be in and one or both can be omitted. Just make sure that you only have one value per. For example, you shouldn't have both repeat-x and no-repeat.

Now, your subverse should look snazzy with your new banner!

If you have any questions, feel free to ask! :-)
